decision: Continue the source-backed parity audit without agents
why: The operator requires personal investigation and implementation; previous desktop-access and shell-agent claims were contradicted by installed source

decision: treated Cursor desktop 3.27.22 as installed host source and recorded the earlier absence claim as wrong
why: the desktop app exists under /usr/share/cursor/resources/app and holds the local agent runtime

decision: marked earlier CLI chunk citations as unverifiable
why: no installed CLI version contains 5622.index.js or 8008.index.js and .audit/pstack-parity-2026-11-05 is missing

decision: captured whole functions with @babel/parser instead of fixed slices
why: fixed slices cut functions mid-body and cannot prove completeness

decision: added the shell subagent with only bash and bash_background
why: desktop Jle defines shell behind a flag and Mle keeps only SHELL; team-kit names subagent_type shell

decision: loaded bundled agents with Cursor plugin-agent rules: inherit model, no tools, no background, readonly only from permissionMode
why: CLI 2026.10.22 and both desktop agent extensions build plugin agents with model inherit, tools [] and no isBackground

decision: framed each child reminder as Cursor Hle(Ble) and used explore text verbatim except the product name
why: desktop prepends one system_reminder with the shared reminder and the custom-subagent framing

decision: ignored an unresolvable fast alias and rejected an empty model
why: desktop yAe returns unknown for fast and the resolver takes the ignore_fast path; empty model throws

decision: failed a resume that names another subagent_type with desktop text and dropped the ignored-model note
why: desktop uIe throws on a type mismatch and silently keeps the prior model

decision: left Pi steering of a running agent in place for now and recorded it as an open divergence
why: desktop and the live CLI capture fail a resume of a running agent unless interrupt is enabled; changing it is a separate unit

decision: kept raw Cursor code captures in the ignored .audit tree and committed only scripts, hashes, offsets, and derived strings
why: the repository is public and the captures are Cursor proprietary code
evidence: git remote and gh repo view: PUBLIC; notes.md Evidence layout

decision: failed a follow-up to a running agent with Cursor text and deleted the steering machinery
why: desktop agent-host throwIfFollowupTargetsBusyRun and the live CLI schema both refuse; pstack never says Task steers
result: tests green; mutations running-text and lock-mapping caught

decision: restored pstack wording for steer and hold orders in poteto-mode and multi-phase-plan
why: the port had rewritten them to promise a Task resume steer that Cursor does not provide

decision: used the Task description and parameter text from a live CLI session, checked equal to the desktop builder
why: probe-task.mjs runs desktop oPe with the live flags and asserts byte equality with the live capture
result: tests green; mutations task-description and resume-param caught

decision: kept Pi error wording for an unknown subagent_type
why: Cursor wraps every invalid argument in its generic validation format with the full input schema; the contract (reject with the list) already holds

decision: measured Pi tool text against a live session and replaced paraphrases with the declared text
why: TodoWrite, SwitchMode, and GenerateImage kept 11 to 24 percent of the words the model reads in Cursor
result: tests green; mutations todo-text and switch-text caught

decision: removed only the Debug and Ask modes from SwitchMode and two Pi-absent remarks from AwaitShell
why: Pi has no Debug or Ask mode, no AwaitShell renderer, and no user backgrounding of shells

decision: matched AwaitShell patterns with re2js and added waiting_for_subagent with Cursor text
why: Cursor sends pattern to RE2 and throws DRe for waiting_for_subagent; Pi used JavaScript RegExp
evidence: desktop AwaitShell schema and DRe; test/background-shell.test.ts; test/e2e/background-shell.e2e.test.ts
result: tests green; mutations await-re2 and await-subagent caught

decision: tightened two tests whose mutations failed only by thrown error or timeout
why: a mutation should fail on an assertion in seconds, not on a 45 second timeout

decision: used desktop AskQuestion string literals for its description and fields, and dropped the option description field
why: desktop mSe declares no option description, so Cursor strips one a model sends and shows labels only; the old test assumed transcript fields were schema fields
evidence: probe-tools.mjs Babel literal search; test/ask.test.ts; test/e2e/ask.e2e.test.ts
result: tests green; mutations ask-text and ask-option-description caught

decision: rendered Task result texts with the desktop agent host formatter and matched them
why: Pi appended a Transcript line, wrapped preformatted replies twice, and used no No output text
result: tests green; mutations result-preformatted and result-transcript caught

decision: corrected the claim that pstack never uses fork
why: orchestrate.md says Fork when new work needs a worker built state; the earlier search matched only fork_turns and backticked fork

decision: ran Verify, Confirm, and Fact-check passes personally
why: the operator forbade other agents, so no independent reviewer took part
result: gates green; 5 of 5 workflow checks; findings recorded

decision: wrote 19 behaviors with all 17 fields, including gaps and differences
why: the earlier 133-row inventory stays the file-level map; these rows supersede it where they overlap

decision: bumped pi-pstack to 0.15.36-pi.18 and reworded the branch commits to Conventional Commit subjects
why: the release workflow publishes an untagged version on merge, and the repository titles commits type(scope): subject; rewording changed every branch SHA, so the SHA in the 06:00:10Z row no longer names a commit, and a squash merge will change them again
evidence: package.json, bun.lock, CHANGELOG.md, parity-status.md; git log main..HEAD
